name: global-cli-worktree-drift
title: Keep the global Proof-or-Stop executable working across dist rebuilds and worktrees
description: The global proof-or-stop command is unreliable between sessions. Today (2026-09-02) proof-or-stop session_brief died with permission denied because packages/main/dist/cli.js was 0644 after the 13:29 rebuild; earlier (draft global-cli-worktree-drift) the /opt/homebrew/bin symlink resolved into the unrelated .worktrees/B-fe8f checkout. RED (repro probe rp-mtk46lj8-90q9av, red-reviewed rr-mtk4acx4-oqze5c, script red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs): tsc emits a shebang entry as 0644, and scripts/build-main-with-binding.mjs + scripts/promote-dist.mjs never restore the executable bit on the package.json bin target after promoting dist.staging into dist, so every real re-emit breaks the global symlink that npm link chmod-ed once. GREEN candidate proven in a scratch worktree: promote-dist.mjs restoreBinExecutableBits(dist) after promotion restores a 0644 bin target to 0755 and the script exits 0. Scope: restore bin executable bits in the build pipeline (both main and utils builds), commit the red script as packages/main/tests/red/red-global-cli-exec-bit.mjs, and add a doctor/verify check that the global executable realpath points at the canonical main checkout and is executable, with the exact repoint/reinstall remediation printed.
